name: Lily Loud
source:
Lily is the last addition to the family, and the youngest of the sisters, she is and will NOT be a dateable/lewdeable/fuckeable character in the game. Yes, I'm breaking the 4th wall here and letting you know that! You get to be [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]me[/url] and fuck almost everyone else in this game, but [b]Lily is off the table![/b]

Now that being said, We all love Lily, despite having to change her diapers. She's the sweetest person in the house next to [url=https://vndb.org/c151354]Leni[/url], and she loves all of us. Nobody can get angry at Lily, and we all go out of our way to take care of her and have fun with her. Lily is great for lifting your spirits if you ever feel down!

[In game description]
